# Rule 0: Don’t Be a Dick. Play with Respect.
- Practice common sense while consulting these rules. The rules are guidelines for the server and should interpreted in best faith for the current situation. - The Server Staff retains the right to issue Permanent Bans to players that they consider to be a consistent net negative to the community and server, without the need for any specific Rule to be broken, but only with the head admins approval. If you feel this punishment was excessive, please reach out to a head admin. - When in doubt, please Adminhelp any question you may have about the Server Rules.
